literal_semantic_review.literal_label: Rez-de-chaussée d’activités se déployant sur l’espace public
literal_semantic_review.meaning: A2 programming orientation for ground-floor activities interacting with public space, including cultural facilities, services and terraces, supporting public-space attraction and recreational use along the lake and Veveyse.
literal_semantic_review.implementation: Through plans d’affectation A1.1 and briefs for relevant public-space requalification projects; retain heritage and neighbourhood context.

native_style_mapping.dash_meaning: Preserve original dash pattern; legend supplies no separate current/planned legal status for these two strokes.

literal_semantic_review.geometry_meaning: Original native open wavy cartographic line supports; not a frontage polygon, ground-floor floorplate, or measured building facade.
limits: No current tenant/business inventory or installed terrace inferred.
No public access right, building right, use entitlement, required retail percentage, residual capacity or lease availability inferred.
Native line geometry preserves actual source paths and dash styles; do not buffer into areas or associate parcels.
Decorative raster shadows are excluded from geographic support.
Whole raw source support must pass frozen hull and Vevey gates; no cropping to manufacture eligibility.
Source precision remains unknown; source base-coordinate alignment is not thematic positional accuracy.
